items.title: The Questions That Defined WMT's Earnings Call
items.summary: Walmart is spending billions on a price war, but its latest earnings call revealed the real debate is whether a new profit engine or a one-time windfall is footing the bill.

items.title: Kroger (KR) Rolls Out Combined Grocery And Prescription Delivery Nationwide
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE: KR) has rolled out a combined grocery and prescription delivery service through Instacart across nearly all Kroger-owned banners. The new option lets customers place a single Instacart order for both groceries and eligible prescriptions. The launch supports Kroger's omni-channel approach and aims to deepen customer loyalty in digital grocery and health services. This kind of grocery and pharmacy tie up points to a wider income focused retail trend that many investors watch...

items.title: Walmart Keeps Cratering: 45% Gains Are Expected From A Respected Wall Street Pro
items.summary: Walmart just beat earnings and raised guidance, then watched its stock sink while every peer in the sector rallied. One Wall Street analyst sees that reaction as the setup for a massive rebound most investors are too spooked to consider.

items.title: Kroger partners with Instacart on combined delivery service
items.summary: The offering is now available across almost all Kroger-owned banners, including Fred Meyer, Ralphs and Harris Teeter.

items.title: The Premium On WMT Stock Vs What Its Peers Deliver
items.summary: Walmart's stock commands a premium price tag, but its growth and profit numbers look more like they belong in the bargain aisle.

items.title: How a Negative Beta Bet Can Protect Your Portfolio From an AI Selloff
items.summary: AI is shaking up a lot of things—including which stocks investors can expect to hold up in a market selloff.  Investors have long relied on a mathematical measure known as beta to judge market risk.  A stock with a beta of 1 tends to move in line with the stock market.
